CustomField.description: Optional additional SOQL WHERE condition applied when querying this Context's records, in addition to the Relationship Field match. Must reference fields on the Context Object (or its direct relationships).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Example: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Enterprise_Deal' or StageName != 'Closed Lost'. Leave blank to include all related records.
CustomField.label: Filter Criteria
